body:
Scope ID: `FORM-D3`. Size: **Medium**. Scoped on 2026-10-05; acceptance remains open.

Owner: family canonical bodies and maturity/novelty/relations.

Dependencies: [CUR-07](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/issues/54), [FORM-M1](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/issues/68)

## Work

Review all168 exact qualified statements, assumptions,non-vacuity and nearest topics family-by-family. Rank substantive strengthening with library seams, proof estimates and positive/boundary witnesses; implement only bounded reviewed existing-owner slices.

## Acceptance

Each row has justified disposition; priority proofs name exact missing content and native/axiom/review acceptance. Signature/maturity/coverage projections remain deterministic; authored theorem-backed relations have qualified witnesses.

## Failure controls and claim boundary

No compile/import/numerical-driven promotion, cosmetic rename, duplicate topics or automatic sealed-roster expansion.

## Canonical references

- [config/theorem_maturity.yaml](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/blob/main/config/theorem_maturity.yaml)
- [config/formalism_novelty.yaml](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/blob/main/config/formalism_novelty.yaml)
- [config/formalism_relations.yaml](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/blob/main/config/formalism_relations.yaml)
- [src/fep_lean/catalogue/bodies](https://github.com/ActiveInferenceInstitute/fep_formal/blob/main/src/fep_lean/catalogue/bodies)

Closure requires actual exact-source commands, results and retained receipts, with independent review where specified. Remove its open TODO row only after acceptance; retain delivery facts in changelog/history. Size describes implementation scope, not a semantic-version promise.
title: [FORM-D3] Review all 168 theorem proxies and rank substantive strengthening
